findings.summary: Unexplained minus signs ('−0.04%', '−1,030 ₪') next to the recommended fund look like losing money.
English index names on a dark background make the page feel not meant for the reader.
The 86,045 ₪ result assumes an unchosen 7% return without clearly saying it could be lower.
Long list of banks with many numbers and coloured bars is tiring.
Cost bar colours (orange/yellow, red/pink) are too close to tell apart.
Jargon such as קרן מחקה, נאמן, דמי משמרת, הזוג.
Unclear who 'מקור' is, so the reader doubts the advice.
